Aluminium industry seeks duty changes to improve competitiveness

The downstream aluminium industry is advocating for changes in import duties to enhance its competitiveness. Different segments of the industry appear to have differing proposals regarding the specific duty adjustments needed. These requests highlight ongoing discussions about trade policy and its impact on domestic manufacturing.
